sentences.en: The Okinawans came to be forced to live alongside life-threatening danger.
sentences.zh: 1. 琉球人最终被迫在生命受到威胁的情况下生活。

sentences.en: The Algerian constitution acknowledges Berber as an official language alongside Arabic.
sentences.zh: 2. 阿尔及利亚宪法承认柏柏尔语与阿拉伯语一样是官方语言。

sentences.en: In Algeria, Berber is an official language alongside Arabic.
sentences.zh: 3. 在阿尔及利亚，柏柏尔语和阿拉伯语都是官方语言。
